subject: Asterix Labs SIG / CAIQ intake — scheduling, artifact owners, and dataflow clarifications
messages:
From: Maya Singh <security@asterixlabs.com>

Date: Tue, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG + CAIQ intake — quick scheduling and initial asks

Hi Jasmine / Marissa,

Thanks for the intro earlier — I’m leading the security intake for Asterix Labs. We’re running a SIG and CAIQ review for vendors this quarter and would like to schedule a 45–60 minute intake call to go over scope, evidence owners, and any CAIQ clarifications.

Proposed times (PT):
- Thu 10/29 10:00–11:00
- Thu 10/29 14:00–15:00
- Fri 10/30 09:00–10:00

On the call we’d like:
- A short CAIQ walkthrough (sections we typically triage)
- Who will own each evidence item (logging, encryption, access control)
- Where artifacts will be uploaded (S3/GDrive preferred)

Initial asks so we can prepare:
- A copy of Redwood’s SIG/CAIQ prefilled where available (if not, a template is fine)
- High-level dataflow diagram (PII flows, external integrations)
- Point of contact for on-call logs / auditor access (name + email)

I attached a quick intake spreadsheet to capture owners.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Security Manager, Asterix Labs
security@asterixlabs.com

Maya — thanks for the clear list. We can take the lead on the CAIQ walkthrough and assign artifact owners on the call. Availability from our side (PT):
- Thu 10/29 10:00–10:45 — OK for Jasmine/Marissa/Ben (we can stretch to 60 min if needed)
- Thu 10/29 14:00 — limited for Ben but OK for Jasmine/Marissa

Agenda proposal (45 min):
1) 5m quick intros + scope confirmation
2) 20m CAIQ highlights — Jasmine (controls where we frequently have Qs)
3) 10m evidence mapping & owners — Marissa (CS lead)
4) 5m artifact transfer & next steps — Ben (SE)
5) buffer / action log

Owners we’ll bring to the call:
- CAIQ / control clarifications: Jasmine Liu (security & compliance)
- Logging / sample exports / retention: Marissa Cole (Customer Success)
- Architecture / dataflow questions: Ben Carter (Sales Engineer)

I attached our current SIG/CAIQ template to speed things up. For the dataflow, a simple diagram (drawn or sequence list) is fine. If you can confirm which time works, I’ll send a calendar invite with a secure artifact upload link (we prefer a short-lived S3 presigned or shared Drive folder with restricted access).

Jasmine Liu

jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com

Thanks — Thu 10/29 10:00 PT works for us.

A couple of clarifying questions ahead of the call so we can prioritize artifacts:
1) Can you confirm whether customer data at rest is encrypted with CMKs managed by Redwood or the customer? We’ll need key custodian details.
2) For log exports, can you provide a sample (1–2 days) showing format and retention headers?
3) Any SOC 2 summary report or attestation available to share prior to the call?

If you can attach the SOC 2 summary and a short dataflow diagram to the invite, that would be helpful. Our procurement contact (procure@asterixlabs.com) may also join for a brief contract/PO discussion — I’ve cc’d them.

Maya

- Zoom link + recording consent (please confirm if Asterix prefers the call not to be recorded)
- Shared GDrive folder (restricted) for artifacts — temporary access granted to Maya + procure@asterixlabs.com; we’ll switch to a presigned S3 path for larger logs after the call.

Pre-call artifacts requested (please drop in Drive before the meeting if possible):

- Dataflow diagram (png / pdf)

Quick answers to the clarifying questions you raised:

- Log sample: Marissa will bring a sanitized 48-hour sample to the call if you don’t upload one beforehand.
- SOC 2: We can share a high-level SOC 2 summary on the Drive now; full report available under NDA.

Action items assigned:
- Jasmine: CAIQ walkthrough + control clarifications on call
- Marissa: logging samples & retention discussion
- Ben: architecture questions & demo slot for any telemetry proofs

See you Thursday.
